page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, built on the x86_64 architecture and managed under the KVM hypervisor. The system provides 56 dedicated vCPUs paired with 224 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 CPU-to-memory balance with 4.0 GB of memory per core. Hardware acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA P4 GPUs delivering a combined total of 16 GB VRAM. Network performance is backed by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Local storage is absent, meaning disk storage must be provisioned via attached network volumes.

The combination of 56 vCPUs, 224 GB RAM, and dual NVIDIA P4 GPUs creates a resource profile geared toward multi-threaded tasks with lightweight graphics acceleration requirements. The absence of local NVMe SSD storage introduces reliance on network storage for throughput and latency. From a hardware density perspective, this instance balances high host core allocation with power-efficient acceleration hardware.

Workloads suited for this server configuration include AI model inference, multi-channel video transcode processing, computer vision pipelines, image processing services, and general parallel computing workloads where low-power GPU acceleration suffices.
